objective: Replace the flawed CW-12 admission-publication locking boundary and close the late resume peer-replacement race without weakening pause or identity guarantees.
must_fix: Remove the publication_lock/CW11 lock inversion. No code may hold a coordinator publication or transition lock while acquiring the SerializedReviewAdmission lock, and no CW11 callback may need such a lock to finish.

Introduce an authoritative fail-closed admission fence whose pause linearization is visible to admit_and_dispatch without coordinator-lock reentry. Once pause pending is published to that fence, no new automatic review may be admitted even if a stale display/state copy is in flight.
Keep any mirrored AutomationState publication deadlock-free and convergence-safe under out-of-order publishers; it must not be the sole safety boundary.

Bind automatic admission/dispatch after resume to the exact reconciled manager and worker session/generation (or an equivalent monotonic peer epoch) so a peer replacement after any sequential probe is observed before automatic work can run and forces held/reconciliation-needed state.

A resume may report success only if the exact binding remains valid at its commit boundary; if a late switch is detected, repause both peers, journal resume_failed, and keep the authoritative admission fence set.

Preserve pause(A)/bind(B) serialization, exact stop-event correlation, durability behavior, no replay, manual TUI independence, real status evidence, and public API compatibility unless the smallest safe API extension is required.
required_regressions: Barrier stale-unpaused publisher paused immediately before setter: pause fence blocks review throughout, not only at final convergence.
Exact lock-cycle harness from final review completes without timeout/deadlock and admission stays safe.
Manager replacement during worker final probe, after final probe, and immediately before first automatic admission cannot produce successful dispatch on stale binding.
High-cycle concurrent pause/resume/bind/admission stress proves no deadlock and admission/fence consistency.
verification: Run focused regressions repeatedly, all pause/status/atomic-admission tests, actual OMP live probe, and relevant full regressions.
constraints: Do not edit contracts, workflow/observation evidence, tickets, PLAN, or ledger records.
Use apply_patch for source/test edits; preserve unrelated changes; no destructive git, uv, local .venv, commit, publish, or deploy.
report: new admission linearization and lock-order invariant
